label: In every possible history, each moment with a contingent concrete thing present has a founded past
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred: in every history accessible from the selected world, every moment at which some contingent concrete individual is present has no endless descending sequence of moments below it. It denies horn H2 (an endless populated past) for every accessible history in which a contingent concrete thing is present at all; histories with no contingent concrete thing present are unconstrained. It is not a claim that time has a first moment, nor a metric finitude claim, and it mentions no cause.
